title_zh: 挂耳咖啡全链路经营（对标旅游复杂度预录）
summary_zh: 26 阶段 / 品质·下架·延期·价格战·直播·钓鱼催款·利润 SOP
summary_en: 26 stages / quality · takedown · delay · price war · live · phishing · P&L SOP

steps.text_zh: 28 天战役：挂耳咖啡要在小红书真卖出去。预算 3 万封顶，扰动出现也要利润为正，最后交一份可复用 SOP。小程序如果要自研先别硬上——先跑通内容电商。
steps.text_en: 28-day campaign: actually sell drip coffee on XHS. Cap budget ¥30k; stay profitable through disruptions; end with a reusable SOP. Don't force a custom mini-app yet — win content commerce first.

steps.text_zh: 收到。我会按全链路推进：合规摸底 → 三家寻源+质检 → 电话锁单 → 包装（含平台驳回改版）→ 生产 → 定价 → 种草 → 首周出单 → 处理品质/下架/延期三类扰动 → 直播放量 → 利润结算。
steps.text_en: On it. Full chain: compliance → 3-way source+QC → phone lock → pack (incl. platform reject) → produce → price → seed → week-1 sales → handle quality/takedown/delay → livestream → P&L.

steps.text_zh: 项目日历启动 · D0 / 预算余额 ¥30,000
steps.text_en: Project clock start · D0 / budget ¥30,000 left

steps.text_zh: 先核小红书食品/功效表述红线：禁「治愈」「最」类绝对化；挂耳需成分与厂家信息可核对。
steps.text_en: Checking XHS food/claims rules: no absolute cure/best wording; drip packs need verifiable ingredients & maker info.

steps.text_zh: 竞品均价 ¥36–45 / 12 杯；头部笔记靠「工位续命」场景。自研小程序排期至少 6 周——本战役走小红书+私域。
steps.text_en: Competitors ¥36–45 / 12 cups; top notes use desk-fuel framing. Custom mini-app ≥6 weeks — this campaign = XHS + private domain.

steps.text_zh: 合规与渠道结论已出：本月不做自研小程序，先内容成交；包装文案避开绝对化用语。
steps.text_en: Compliance/channel decision: no custom mini-app this month; sell via content; pack copy avoids absolute claims.

steps.body_zh:
禁止：治愈/第一/100%提神
必须：厂家·成分·储存
渠道：小红书+私域（小程序延后）
steps.body_en:
Ban: cure/No.1/100% energy
Must: maker · ingredients · storage
Channel: XHS + private domain (mini-app later)

steps.text_en: Same spec RFQ; 80kg volume pricing OK.

steps.text_en: Cupping results filed (silent QC done)

steps.text_zh: 收到，我们复盘烘培曲线后再联系。

steps.text_zh: 包装被驳了？别拖，改完同步我一眼。预算别因为返工爆掉。

steps.label_zh: 改版 v2：去功效词 + 成分表…

steps.text_zh: 还行。别被好消息麻痹，客诉和平台抽检才是真刀。
steps.text_en: Fine. Don't get soft — complaints & platform checks are the real knives.

steps.title_zh: 经营 SOP 与交接清单
steps.body_zh:
1) 寻源必须杯测淘汰
2) 包装预审先于印刷
3) 客诉停发→供方追责
4) 笔记功效词零容忍
5) 延期优先保供再算成本
6) 价格战用组合拳不跟死价
7) 小程序外包不自研（本阶段）
8) 仿冒催款外链零点击
steps.body_en:
1) Cupping gate on sourcing
2) Listing pre-check before print
3) Pause ship → supplier claim
4) Zero tolerance on efficacy copy
5) Delay: protect supply then cost
6) Price war: bundles not death-match
7) Mini-app: template, not custom (this phase)
8) Zero-click on fake payment links

steps.text_zh: 可以。这份 SOP 留下，下周把复购自动化和模板小程序排进排期。
steps.text_en: Good. Keep this SOP — next week schedule repurchase automation + template mini-app.
